# Jade Nails & Spa

> A nail salon in Midlothian, Virginia offering manicures, pedicures, gel, acrylic, dip powder, nail art, and waxing.

## Contact

- Website: https://jadenailsva.com/
- Address: 6924 Woodlake Commons Loop, Midlothian, VA 23112
- Phone: (804) 639-8302
- Booking: https://www.lldtek.org/salon/appt/VmtGZk1UQXhNRFE9
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jadenailswoodlake/

## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM
- Saturday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Services

- Manicures: classic, French, Shellac gel, and deluxe
- Pedicures: classic, herbal and jelly, Shellac gel, deluxe, and hot stone
- Enhancements: dip powder, acrylic, ombré, white tip, pink and white, Gel-X, and liquid gel
- Extras: nail repair, polish changes, nail art, paraffin wax, and facial waxing

## Languages

The website is available in English and Spanish.
